## 022240cb671b

**Classification: reproduced distribution-coverage defect.** Audited source SHA-256: `d62d2201275f3898b4c47382ac0563defafb91b20745f8143fe7e66860f8b19c`.

The advertised `border_touch` path can shift content only upward and/or leftward. Normal placement uses a one-cell margin, so no other production path reaches an edge. Thus the generator cannot emit bottom-edge or right-edge contact, even though the canonical held-out test has content touching the right border.

`checks/audit/022240cb671b/probe.py` generated 400 explicit `texture="border_touch"` inputs over seeds `0..99` and sample indices `0..3`. All passed `self_check`. Contact counts were: top **206**, left **302**, bottom **0**, right **0**; combinations were left-only 194, top-only 98, and top+left 108. Code-path analysis establishes the omitted orientations, while `checks/audit/022240cb671b/report.json` retains all counts, representative inputs, canonical side annotations, and the source hash.

The independent strict audit preset also failed because this target declares no executable semantic contract; it has no task-local tests. See `checks/audit/022240cb671b/combined/` and `check.log`. I did not edit the audited target.
